payloads.name: PS5 Medic
payloads.description: Full-screen app: checks the live state of the homebrew setup (firmware, HEN, kstuff, ShadowMount+, payloads, files, configs), explains errors in plain language and repairs safely with backup and undo. Note: for the DualSense controller start it via websrv (big app loader); as a plain payload it can only be used without a controller.
payloads.author: strongt1me

payloads.name: PS5 Medic Diagnose
payloads.description: Small diagnostic payload without a user interface: writes the report to /data/ps5medic/last_check.txt and stores a snapshot in /data/ps5medic/snapshots/.
payloads.author: strongt1me
